tools.name: bazi_chart
tools.description: Calculate a Chinese BaZi (Four Pillars of Destiny) chart from a birth date and optional time and gender: four pillars, Day Master, element balance, ten gods and 10-year luck pillars. Use when the user asks for their BaZi, Four Pillars, Chinese birth chart, Day Master or element balance.

tools.name: bazi_year_outlook
tools.description: How a given year (default 2027, the Fire Goat year Ding Wei) interacts with a person's BaZi chart: the year's ten gods for their Day Master and any clashes or combinations with their natal pillars. Use when the user asks about their luck, fortune or forecast for a specific year.

tools.name: bazi_compatibility
tools.description: Compare two people's BaZi charts: Day Master element relationship, day-branch clash or combination, and how each person's elements fill the other's gaps. Use for relationship, marriage or partner compatibility questions.
